dedupe_keys.name: gis dataset for the distribution of flooding areas in nuova pescara

description: Antonio Bocca and colleagues publish a GIS dataset showing the distribution of flooding areas across Nuova Pescara, Italy. The CRESCO Adria deliverable covers Pescara, Montesilvano and Spoltore and is supplied as a freely downloadable ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The June 2026 deposit identifies the municipal planning context and the GIS output. These spatial layers can be intersected with infrastructure locations to construct local flood-exposure scenarios. The public summary does not establish the flood mechanisms, return periods, coordinate reference system, internal file format or map uncertainty, which users must check before quantitative risk calculations. The separate G6 territorial-profile draft covers broader adaptation profiles, not explicitly including this flood-layer archive. No related catalogue record covers it. The ZIP was not downloaded, and the mapped flooding was not independently validated.
